cases.input: Run headless. intent=create. Brief: InsuLens, a claims-triage tool for mid-market insurers. Target users: claims adjusters. Scope: triage queue only, no payments. Produce prd.md with frontmatter (title, status, created, updated) and a JSON status block.
rubric: writes prd.md with YAML frontmatter containing title and status
names InsuLens and the triage scope without inventing payments functionality
ends with a JSON status block (intent/status fields)

cases.input: Run headless. intent=validate. The prd.md is in the workspace: title set, status draft, but no success metrics and scope says 'everything'. Critique it without changing it.

does not rewrite the artifact (critique only)
